moments.title: Bebe Rexha Turns 37
moments.blurb: American singer-songwriter Bebe Rexha, known for hits like 'Meant to Be' and 'I'm a Mess', celebrates her 37th birthday today.

angles.copy: Sending birthday wishes to the incredible Bebe Rexha, turning 37 today! What's your favourite track from the powerhouse vocalist?

angles.name: Bebe Rexha's Biggest Hits
angles.copy: From 'Meant to Be' to 'I'm a Mess', Bebe Rexha has given us some massive tunes. Celebrating her 37th birthday with her best records!

moments.title: Great British Bake Off Returns
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off is set to return to Channel 4 this week, with the new series kicking off on Wednesday, September 2nd, and Nigella Lawson joining as a new judge.

moments.title: UK Heatwave Forecast for Next Week
moments.blurb: The UK is bracing for another heatwave next week, with temperatures expected to reach up to 29°C in parts of England, particularly in southern and western regions, around September 5th-7th.

angles.name: Summer's Last Blast?
angles.copy: Don't pack away the shorts just yet! A heatwave is forecast for the UK next week, with temperatures soaring to 29°C in some areas. How are you planning to make the most of it?

moments.title: End Of The Road Festival Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The End Of The Road Festival, known for its eclectic mix of music and arts, begins on September 3rd and runs until September 6th in the South West.

angles.name: Road Trip to End Of The Road
angles.copy: Who's heading to the End Of The Road Festival this weekend? Kicking off on Thursday, it's set to be four days of incredible music and art in the South West!

angles.name: Festival Vibes
angles.copy: The End Of The Road Festival is almost here! Get ready for a unique blend of indie, folk, and alternative acts starting September 3rd. What's on your must-see list?

moments.title: British Country Music Festival in Blackpool
moments.blurb: The British Country Music Festival brings three days of country and Americana artists to Blackpool from September 4th to 6th.

angles.name: Country Comes to Blackpool
angles.copy: Yeehaw! The British Country Music Festival is taking over Blackpool this weekend, starting Friday. Three days of incredible talent and good vibes!

angles.name: Blackpool's Country Weekend
angles.copy: Dust off your cowboy boots! The British Country Music Festival kicks off Friday in Blackpool, showcasing the best of UK and international country music.

moments.title: Blackpool Illuminations Begin
moments.blurb: The iconic Blackpool Illuminations, a major annual light show, officially begin their 2026 run on September 4th.

angles.name: Let There Be Light!
angles.copy: Blackpool is about to get a whole lot brighter! The famous Illuminations switch on this Friday, September 4th. Who's planning a trip?

angles.name: Blackpool's Annual Spectacle
angles.copy: A UK tradition returns! The Blackpool Illuminations light up from Friday. It's a dazzling display that's been captivating visitors since 1879!

moments.title: Steve Jones Turns 71
moments.blurb: Steve Jones, the influential guitarist of the legendary punk band Sex Pistols, celebrates his 71st birthday on September 3rd.

angles.name: Punk Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Steve Jones, the guitar legend from the Sex Pistols! What's your favourite punk anthem he shredded on?

angles.name: God Save The Guitarist
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy birthday to the one and only Steve Jones of the Sex Pistols, turning 71 on September 3rd! Anarchy in the UK, indeed!

moments.title: Al Jardine Turns 84
moments.blurb: Al Jardine, co-founder and guitarist of the iconic American rock band The Beach Boys, celebrates his 84th birthday on September 3rd.

angles.name: Beach Boy Birthday
angles.copy: Good vibrations for Al Jardine! The co-founder of The Beach Boys turns 84 on September 3rd. What's your favourite Beach Boys classic?

angles.name: Celebrating Al Jardine
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 84th birthday to The Beach Boys' Al Jardine! His harmonies are timeless. What's the first Beach Boys song that comes to mind?

moments.title: Macy Gray Turns 59
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning soul singer Macy Gray, known for her distinctive raspy voice and hit 'I Try', celebrates her 59th birthday on September 6th.

angles.name: Celebrating a Soul Voice
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 59th birthday to the unmistakable voice of Macy Gray! Her unique sound has left a lasting mark on music.

moments.title: Roger Waters Turns 83
moments.blurb: Roger Waters, co-founder, bassist, and principal lyricist of the legendary progressive rock band Pink Floyd, celebrates his 83rd birthday on September 6th.

angles.name: Pink Floyd Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to Pink Floyd's iconic Roger Waters on September 6th! His vision shaped some of rock's most monumental albums.

angles.name: The Wall Creator
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring legacy of Roger Waters, turning 83 this Friday. From 'The Wall' to 'Dark Side of the Moon', his work is legendary.
